column1: description
A large pothole is damaging vehicles on the main road.
The road surface is broken near the school.
There are many cracks in the road.
The road has deep holes after heavy rain.
Cars struggle to pass along the damaged road.
Garbage is piling up beside the market.
Trash has not been collected for several days.
People are dumping rubbish near the river.
The public waste bin is overflowing.
Plastic waste is scattered around the school.
There is no water supply in our neighborhood.
A pipe is leaking water onto the street.
Residents are receiving dirty drinking water.
The community water pump is not working.
Several houses have no running water.
The streetlight is not working at night.
The streetlamp near the school is broken.
Several lights along the main road are switched off.
The public streetlight needs repair.
The lamp near the bus stop does not turn on.
Rainwater is flooding the road because drains are blocked.
The roadside drainage channel is full of mud.
Water cannot flow through the blocked drain.
A damaged drainage pipe is causing water to collect.
The neighborhood floods when it rains heavily.
